WITH fund_history_counts AS (
    SELECT
        portfolioref,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fundperf IS NOT NULL) AS years_with_perf
    FROM annual_returns
    GROUP BY portfolioref
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fundperf IS NOT NULL) >= 10 -- enough history, at least 10 years
),

annual_outperformance AS (
    SELECT
        ar.portfolioref,
        ar.calendaryear,
        ar.fundperf,
        ar.categoryperf,
        (ar.fundperf - ar.categoryperf) AS annual_outperformance
    FROM annual_returns ar
    JOIN fund_history_counts fhc ON ar.portfolioref = fhc.portfolioref
    WHERE ar.fundperf IS NOT NULL
      AND ar.categoryperf IS NOT NULL
),

average_performance AS (
    SELECT
        portfolioref,
        AVG(CASE WHEN categoryperf > 0 THEN annual_outperformance END) AS avg_up_perf,
        AVG(CASE WHEN categoryperf <= 0 THEN annual_outperformance END) AS avg_down_perf,
        (AVG(CASE WHEN categoryperf > 0 THEN annual_outperformance END) - AVG(CASE WHEN categoryperf <= 0 THEN annual_outperformance END)) AS capture_diff
    FROM annual_outperformance
    GROUP BY portfolioref
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT calendaryear) >= 10
),

funds_with_geozone AS (
    SELECT
        f.tickersym,
        f.shortlabel,
        f.parentgroup,
        f.launchdate,
        f.productclass,
        f.fundclass->> 'GeoZone_Class' AS geozone
    FROM funds f
    JOIN fund_history_counts fhc ON f.tickersym = fhc.portfolioref
),

funds_markets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        fgeozone.tickersym,
        fgeozone.shortlabel,
        fgeozone.parentgroup,
        fgeozone.launchdate,
        fgeozone.productclass,
        fgeozone.geozone
    FROM funds_with_geozone fgeozone
    WHERE fgeozone.geozone IS NOT NULL
)

    fm.shortlabel,
    fm.parentgroup,
    fm.geozone AS market,
    ap.avg_up_perf AS average_outperformance_when_market_up,
    ap.avg_down_perf AS average_outperformance_when_market_down,
    ap.capture_diff AS difference_between_up_and_down_market_performance
FROM funds_markets fm
JOIN average_performance ap ON fm.tickersym = ap.portfolioref
ORDER BY fm.geozone, ap.capture_diff DESC NULLS LAST, ap.avg_up_perf DESC NULLS LAST

  fm."Expense_Net" IS NOT NULL
  AND fm."Yield_Rate" IS NOT NULL
  AND fm."Expense_Net" > 0
  AND (fm."Yield_Rate" / fm."Expense_Net") > 15
  AND high_quality_credit_allocation > 0.60

user_query: Find the best fund for each category. Calculate a total score for each fund based on its alpha, sharpe ratio, and expenses. For each fund group with enough funds, find the top fund. Show me the category, ticker, name, and score.
generated_sql:
WITH fund_scores AS (
  SELECT
    f.productclass AS category,
    f.tickersym AS ticker,
    COALESCE(f.shortlabel, f.fulldescription) AS name,
    rm.risk3y -> 'risk_measures_3y' ->> 'Alpha_3Y' AS alpha_3y,
    rm.risk3y -> 'risk_measures_3y' ->> 'Sharpe_Ratio_3Y' AS sharpe_3y,
    f.fundmetrics ->> 'Expense_Net' AS expense_net_float,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY f.productclass
      ORDER BY
        -- Compute score as average of percentile ranks of 5Y Alpha, 3Y Sharpe Ratio, and inverse expense
        -- Since only 3Y alpha is directly accessible, we use 3Y alpha for the purpose
        NULLIF(rm.risk3y -> 'risk_measures_3y' ->> 'Alpha_3Y', '')::numeric DESC NULLS LAST,
        NULLIF(rm.risk3y -> 'risk_measures_3y' ->> 'Sharpe_Ratio_3Y', '')::numeric DESC NULLS LAST,
        NULLIF(f.fundmetrics ->> 'Expense_Net', '')::numeric ASC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM funds f
  JOIN risk_metrics rm ON rm.investmentref = f.tickersym
  WHERE
    f.productclass IS NOT NULL
    AND rm.risk3y -> 'risk_measures_3y' ->> 'Alpha_3Y' IS NOT NULL
    AND rm.risk3y -> 'risk_measures_3y' ->> 'Sharpe_Ratio_3Y' IS NOT NULL
    AND f.fundmetrics ->> 'Expense_Net' IS NOT NULL
),
category_counts AS (
  SELECT
    productclass AS category,
    COUNT(*) AS fund_count
  FROM funds
  WHERE productclass IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY productclass
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
),
percentile_rank_table AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    ticker,
    name,
    alpha_3y::numeric AS alpha,
    sharpe_3y::numeric AS sharpe,
    expense_net_float::numeric AS expense,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY alpha_3y::numeric) AS pr_alpha,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY sharpe_3y::numeric) AS pr_sharpe,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY expense_net_float::numeric DESC) AS pr_inv_expense -- inverse expense rank by ordering descending so low expense gets high PR
  FROM fund_scores
  WHERE category IN (SELECT category FROM category_counts)
),
scored_funds AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    ticker,
    name,
    (pr_alpha + pr_sharpe + pr_inv_expense) / 3 AS total_score
  FROM percentile_rank_table
),
ranked_funds AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    ticker,
    name,
    total_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY total_score DESC) AS rank_in_category
  FROM scored_funds
)
SELECT
  category,
  ticker,
  name,
  total_score
FROM ranked_funds
WHERE rank_in_category = 1
ORDER BY category;

  END AS price_position_pct,
  ftr.moving_averages ->> 'MA_50' AS ma_50,

  CASE
    WHEN ftr.moving_averages ->> 'MA_50' IS NOT NULL AND ftr.moving_averages ->> 'MA_200' IS NOT NULL THEN
      (ftr.moving_averages ->> 'MA_50')::numeric - (ftr.moving_averages ->> 'MA_200')::numeric
    ELSE NULL
  END AS short_term_momentum,
  f.fundclass ->> 'Strategy_Type' AS strategy_type,
  (f.fundmetrics ->> 'Expense_Net')::numeric AS expense_net,
  (f.fundmetrics ->> 'Turnover_Ratio')::numeric AS turnover_ratio,
  COALESCE(
    (ar1.fundperf - ar1.categoryperf),
    0.0
  ) AS annual_fund_outperformance,
  CASE
    WHEN ftr.moving_averages ->> 'MA_50' IS NOT NULL AND ftr.moving_averages ->> 'MA_200' IS NOT NULL THEN
      CASE WHEN ((ftr.moving_averages ->> 'MA_50')::numeric - (ftr.moving_averages ->> 'MA_200')::numeric) > 0 THEN true ELSE false END
    ELSE false
  END AS golden_cross_signal,
  ((f.fundmetrics ->> 'Expense_Net')::numeric - (f.fundmetrics ->> 'Benchmark_Exp')::numeric) AS relative_expense_ratio
FROM funds f
JOIN performance p ON f.tickersym = p.productref
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT moving_averages
  FROM jsonb_to_record(f.tradingdata -> 'moving_averages') AS x("MA_50" numeric, "MA_200" numeric)
) AS ftr ON true
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT ar1.portfolioref, ar1.calendaryear, ar1.fundperf, ar1.categoryperf
  FROM annual_returns ar1
  JOIN (

  ) ar2 ON ar1.portfolioref = ar2.portfolioref AND ar1.calendaryear = ar2.max_year

SELECT
    f.tickersym,
    f.shortlabel,
    f.fulldescription,

    -- Calculate AMV = Information Ratio - (Relative Expense Ratio * 10)

    ( ((fm.fundmetrics->>'Expense_Net')::numeric - (fm.fundmetrics->>'Benchmark_Exp')::numeric) * 10 ) AS active_manager_value
FROM
    funds f
    JOIN risk_metrics rm ON f.tickersym = rm.investmentref
    JOIN funds fm ON fm.tickersym = f.tickersym
WHERE
    rm.risk3y->'risk_measures_3y'->>'Sharpe_Ratio_3Y' IS NOT NULL
    AND fm.fundmetrics->>'Expense_Net' IS NOT NULL
    AND fm.fundmetrics->>'Benchmark_Exp' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    active_manager_value DESC

user_query: Compute a secure-income-efficiency score (yield/expense * high-quality bond pct) and list the top 50 funds.
generated_sql:
SELECT
    f.tickersym,
    f.shortlabel,
    f.fulldescription,
    fm.fundmetrics ->> 'Yield_Rate' AS yield_rate,
    fm.fundmetrics ->> 'Expense_Net' AS expense_net,
    COALESCE(hqc.high_quality_allocation, 0) AS high_quality_bond_pct,
    -- Compute Yield-to-Expense Ratio
    CASE
        WHEN (fm.fundmetrics ->> 'Expense_Net')::numeric > 0
        THEN ((fm.fundmetrics ->> 'Yield_Rate')::numeric / (fm.fundmetrics ->> 'Expense_Net')::numeric) * COALESCE(hqc.high_quality_allocation, 0)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS secure_income_efficiency_score
FROM
    funds f
JOIN
    LATERAL (
        SELECT
            f.fundmetrics
    ) fm ON true
LEFT JOIN (
    -- Calculate total allocation to high-quality bonds (us_government, aaa, aa)
    SELECT
        ba.fundlink,
        SUM(ba.allocationpct) AS high_quality_allocation
    FROM
        bond_allocations ba
    JOIN
        bond_ratings br ON ba.ratinglink = br.ratekey
    WHERE
        br.creditmark ILIKE 'us_government'
        OR br.creditmark ILIKE 'aaa'
        OR br.creditmark ILIKE 'aa'
    GROUP BY
        ba.fundlink
) hqc ON hqc.fundlink = f.tickersym
WHERE
    (fm.fundmetrics ->> 'Yield_Rate') IS NOT NULL
    AND (fm.fundmetrics ->> 'Expense_Net') IS NOT NULL
    AND (fm.fundmetrics ->> 'Expense_Net')::numeric > 0
ORDER BY
    secure_income_efficiency_score DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 50;
